reason: E-Golf4U is going away, so I have to move our 950 members to a system that will still work in five years. I won't pick two founders with no club live yet over Nexxchange or IntoGolf, even with a free pilot, because a failed switch costs me a season of complaints at the desk.
objection: Two people support the core system of an 18-hole club and not one club runs on it yet. Also, GOLF.NL already lets members book and pay, so I'm not sure the club's own app is worth a second migration if this one fails.
would_change_my_mind: Golfclub Zwolle running live for a few months and its board telling me on the phone that members actually use it and support answers on a Saturday.
